crest_point.name: Wave Crest
crest_point.description: Point on the transverse wave where the displacement of medium particles is at maximum positive distance above equilibrium.

trough_point.name: Wave Trough
trough_point.description: Point on the transverse wave where the displacement of medium particles is at maximum negative distance below equilibrium.

amplitude_displacement.name: Wave Amplitude (A)
amplitude_displacement.description: Maximum displacement of a medium particle from its central equilibrium rest position; measured in metres (m).

wavelength_interval.name: Wavelength (λ)
wavelength_interval.description: Distance between two consecutive points that are in phase (such as two consecutive crests); measured in metres (m).

equilibrium_line.name: Equilibrium / Rest Line
equilibrium_line.description: Central reference line representing the undisturbed position of the medium particles when no wave energy is propagating.

wave_propagation_dir.name: Wave Propagation Vector
wave_propagation_dir.description: Horizontal direction in which the continuous train of wave disturbances and energy travels through the medium.

particle_motion_dir.name: Particle Oscillation Axis
particle_motion_dir.description: Vertical axis along which individual particles oscillate perpendicular (at 90°) to the direction of wave propagation.

in_phase_crest.name: Consecutive In-Phase Crest
in_phase_crest.description: Next crest along the wave train that is moving in the identical direction and phase as the first crest.
